name: Portugal
description:
A welcoming European nation on the Atlantic coast with a mild climate, affordable lifestyle, and rich maritime history. Portugal offers excellent wine, beaches, and a growing tech scene in Lisbon.

## Key Highlights
- Affordable cost of living with excellent lifestyle
- Beautiful beaches and mild Mediterranean climate
- Growing tech and startup ecosystem
longdescription: Portugal is a Western European nation known for its Atlantic coastline, mild climate, and rich maritime history. Located on the Iberian Peninsula, Portugal has been a gateway to Europe for centuries. Lisbon, the capital, is increasingly recognized as a vibrant tech hub and startup destination, attracting entrepreneurs and remote workers from around the world. The cost of living is significantly lower than Northern Europe, making Portugal particularly attractive for digital nomads and those seeking affordable European living. Portuguese cuisine is underrated yet excellent, known for fresh seafood, traditional pastries, and world-class wines from the Douro Valley and other regions. The country offers beautiful beaches along both the Atlantic coast and the Algarve, as well as cultural heritage sites and charming traditional towns. Portugal has invested in renewable energy and sustainable infrastructure, ranking among Europe's leaders in clean energy adoption. Healthcare is good and significantly cheaper than many Western countries. Portuguese is the official language, though English proficiency is increasing in urban areas and among younger people. The Portuguese are known for their warmth and welcoming nature. The government has introduced digital visa programs and startup visas to attract foreign talent and entrepreneurs. Portugal combines European stability and quality of life with affordability and a relaxed lifestyle, making it increasingly popular among expats, retirees, and remote professionals seeking a balanced lifestyle without the high costs of Northern Europe.

visas.name: Portugal D6 Family Reunification Visa
visas.description: Portugal's D6 Visa allows non-EU family members of legal Portuguese residents to join them and live together in Portugal, enjoying resident rights including healthcare and education access.

visas.name: Portugal D1 Work Visa
visas.description: Portugal's D1 Work Visa for non-EU nationals who have secured a job offer with a Portuguese employer, allowing long-term residence and the right to work as an employee in Portugal.
benefits: Live and work legally in Portugal

visas.name: Portugal Job Seeker Visa
visas.description: Portugal's job-seeker visa allows non-EU nationals to enter and stay in Portugal for up to 120 days to search for employment or entrepreneurial opportunities, with the option to convert to a work visa.
benefits: Search for work on the ground in Portugal
Convert to work visa if employed

visas.name: Portugal D4 Student Visa
visas.description: Portugal's student visa (D4) for non-EU nationals enrolled in a Portuguese higher education institution or accredited language course for stays longer than 90 days.

visas.name: Portugal Tech Visa
visas.description: Portugal's Tech Visa is designed for highly qualified non-EU professionals in technology and innovation who have a job offer from a certified Tech Visa company in Portugal.
benefits: Work in Portugal's growing tech sector

visas.name: Portugal Startup Visa (D2)
visas.description: Portugal's Startup Visa (D2) for non-EU entrepreneurs who want to develop an innovative startup project in Portugal, requiring endorsement from a certified incubator.

visas.name: Portugal D3 Work Visa
visas.description: Portugal's D3 Visa for highly qualified non-EU professionals in specialised fields such as IT, engineering, healthcare, or research, offering access to the EU Blue Card network.

visas.name: Portugal D2 Freelance & Business Visa
visas.description: Portugal's D2 Visa for non-EU independent professionals and freelancers wishing to provide services or develop a business activity in Portugal on a self-employed basis.

visas.name: Portugal Digital Nomad Visa
visas.description: Portugal's Digital Nomad Visa allows remote workers to live and work in Portugal while employed by a company outside the country. Perfect for freelancers and remote employees.

visas.name: Portugal Golden Visa
visas.description: Portugal's Golden Visa is a residency by investment program offering permanent residency to non-EU citizens who make qualifying investments in Portugal.

visas.name: The D7 Visa (Portugal)
visas.description: The D7 Visa is perfect for retirees or those with passive income streams who want to enjoy Portugal's relaxed lifestyle and affordable healthcare.

Citizenship by Descent.desc: Children of Portuguese citizen parents acquire citizenship automatically. Ancestry up to 3 generations can claim based on descent.

Naturalization.desc:
**Requirements:** 10 years legal residence (6 years for Portuguese speakers, Lusophones, and EU/EFTA citizens), Portuguese language A2 level, integration tests.

**Special:** Persons of Portuguese origin may qualify with reduced residence.

Spouse and Family.desc: Spouses of Portuguese citizens may apply after 2 years marriage with reduced residence requirements.

EU Citizens.desc: EU citizens have special naturalization privileges and may acquire citizenship after 4 years residence.

tax_advice:
- Portugal has progressive income tax rates (14.5% to 48%)
- Corporate tax rate is 19% (15% for companies with turnover <25m euros)
- VAT at 23% (reduced rates of 13%, 6%, and 0%)
- Non-Habitual Resident (NHR) regime offers 10-year tax exemption on foreign income
- Golden Visa holders can benefit from NHR provisions
- Capital gains generally taxed at 28%
- Real estate property transfer tax at varying rates (0.8%-8%)
- Tax residency established if in Portugal 183+ days or have permanent home
local_tips:
- Portuguese easy to learn if you know Spanish; locals appreciate effort
- NHR (Non-Habitual Resident) tax regime available for first 10 years
- Healthcare: Private insurance recommended though public system acceptable
- Cost of living reasonable outside Lisbon and Porto; rural areas very affordable
- Bureaucracy: Register with local authorities (junta de freguesia) immediately
- Golden Visa program well-established and widely understood
- Weather excellent; mild winters in most of country
